signal: XOi took a KKR investment and acquired Specifx to expand its field service asset intelligence platform.

email.body1:
Ryan, saw XOi took the KKR investment and folded in Specifx to expand the asset intelligence platform.

Stepping on the gas like that usually means more in-market contractors in play than business development can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for XOi off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Ryan, quick follow-up for XOi.

After a growth investment, the number on business development usually jumps faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot actually say how many meetings they need to hit the new target, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a recovery effort.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings XOi needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Ryan, last bit of proof for XOi.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how XOi's reply rate likely compares to other growth-backed software companies. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Ryan, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Right after an investment and an acquisition is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a field service motion? I will tailor it to XOi either way.
